canonical_name: No Environmental Protections and Recovery Infrastructure
description: The entity does not authorize, design, develop or acquire, implement, operate, approve, maintain, and monitor environmental protections, software, data backup processes, and recovery infrastructure to meet its objectives.
applicability: Disaster recovery, backup systems, environmental controls

metadata.detection_notes: Review backup policies, disaster recovery plans, environmental controls documentation, redundant infrastructure, and recovery point/time objectives. Check for absence of backup systems, environmental monitoring, or recovery infrastructure.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
